def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_investment = 120.0  # millions of dollars
    gross_return_rate = 0.35
    hurdle_rate = 0.05
    management_fee_rate = 0.02
    incentive_fee_rate = 0.20

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    gross_profit = initial_investment * gross_return_rate
    year_end_aum = initial_investment + gross_profit

    management_fee = year_end_aum * management_fee_rate
    hurdle_profit = initial_investment * hurdle_rate

    incentive_fee_base = gross_profit - hurdle_profit - management_fee
    incentive_fee = incentive_fee_base * incentive_fee_rate

    net_return = gross_profit - management_fee - incentive_fee
    answer = round(net_return, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
